# E2E Third-party (do not install)

**This is a test plugin. Do not install it.** It exists only to exercise the Astra plugins registry's
third-party publishing walk (ROLL-32) end to end — repository binding, release, ingest and serving — from
a third-party GitHub org. It is a copy of `astra-dice-roller` with a different id and is not a real
plugin. It will be withdrawn after the test.
